messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — trying to onboard mistral-mix-7b-q4 into the eval harness and CI is failing on the metric aggregation step. Local runs look fine but CI shows a bunch of token-length mismatches and zeroed metrics. error snippet from CI: `runner: unexpected seq_len 512 vs expected 768`

eval-ci: test_run/1763502461 FAILED — stage: metric-collector — reason: token_length_mismatch (count: 134) — see /artifacts/1763502461/metrics.log

jamal: hmm, token-length mismatch smells like a tokenizer/chat-template mismatch. did the model config specify a new chat_template or tokenizer override? the harness expects Llama-style special tokens by default.

maria_g: config pasted below — added custom chat template and q4 quant profile for this model:
```yaml
model_name: mistral-mix-7b-q4
tokenizer: mistral-mix-tokenizer-v1
chat_template: |
  <|system|> You are RedwoodAssistant.
  <|user|> {user_message}
  <|assistant|>
quant: q4_0
max_seq_len: 768
```

alex: reproduced locally. root cause: eval-runner's prefix/truncation logic looks for the Llama sentinel `` to align KV cache lengths. Mistral tokenizer uses `<|system|>`/`<|user|>` tokens and the code path falls back to a string-based heuristic that mismatches token counts. it then pads/truncates incorrectly, causing metric drop to 0.

jamal: thanks. so we need two changes: (1) make the runner use tokenizer.encode/decode length checks instead of string constants, (2) CI gating should tolerate tiny metric deltas for new tokenizers until we verify templates.

sophie: +1. propose adding a config flag `template_token_mode: tokenizer-aware|legacy` and default it to `tokenizer-aware`. also add a CI config to allow `regression_tolerance: 0.03` for rouge/bleu on first onboarding PR. example gating snippet:
```yaml
ci_gates:
  metric_regressions:
    rouge_l: { tolerance: 0.03 }
    exact_match: { tolerance: 0.02 }
    token_length_mismatch: { allowed: false }
```

alex: I'll open a small PR to change the runner truncation logic to call the tokenizer API to compute tokenized prefix lengths and to stop relying on ``. patch will also add a unit test that loads mistral-mix-tokenizer-v1 and ensures chat_template token counts are stable.

maria_g: awesome. can you also add a short migration note for model_onboarding.md? new models should include `template_token_mode` if they use non-llama tokens.

alex: yep. PR incoming: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/merge_requests/4823 — includes runner fix + test + ci gate.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for branch alex/runner-tokenizer-fix — preview at https://preview.internal/redwood/4823 — CI: 4/5 jobs passing (flaky eval test rerun queued)

jamal: once merged, i'll run a canary onboarding job against staging with the actual quant build and push results to the eval dashboard. if metrics look good we can promote the model.

maria_g: thanks everyone. filing an onboarding issue to track docs/ci/dashboard follow-ups: #MH-612. i'll update the dashboard team to expect a small metric shift after the tokenizer-aware mode is enabled. :thumbsup:
